scope: Current actual live native UI, default clock unchanged, no submitted scores
claim: No time pressure by default. Daily puzzles have no clock. The one head to head mode with a shot clock is a deliberate game rule, and everything else waits for you.
before: Skip to main content DOUKNOWBALL Back Track stats ALPHABET SPRINT A letter drops, you name a player whose surname starts with it. Beat the clock. Pick your pace +1 per player, +1 bonus every 5 in a row. Skips only cost time, but they restart the streak. Relaxed 75s A quicker 75 seconds Best 0 Classic 45s The standard sprint Best 0 Insane 20s 20 seconds of chaos Best 0 Type the player's FULL NAME (Kylian Mbappe) or just the surname, then hit Enter. No suggestions. You have to know it. A bare surname works if only one player fits; when several share it, the full name settles it. Surname counts, so Kylian Mbappe answers M, not K. Each player can only be used once per run. Rare letters with too few players never come up. Start 45s run Report Alphabet Sprint: Timed Soccer Player Name Quiz A quickfire football trivia race. Random letters appear, weighted by how many real players carry them, and you name anyone whose surname starts with the letter before the clock runs out. Streak bonuses reward five in a row, skips are free but reset the streak, and every player can only be used once per run. A letter drops, you name a footballer whose surname starts with it, and the clock does not care about your feelings. Alphabet Sprint is pure recall at speed: no suggestions, no autocomplete, no safety net. Every correct name is a point, streaks pay bonuses, and each player can only be used once per run. It is the rare trivia game where typing speed is a real skill. How to play Alphabet Sprint, a free online soccer naming game Picking a Relaxed, Classic or Insane pace Pick a pace: Relaxed is 75 seconds, Classic is 45, Insane is 20. Typing a surname for the letter shown A big letter appears. Type a player whose surname starts with it and press Enter. ADDING A FIRST NAME WHEN A SURNAME IS SHARED A bare surname works when it can only mean one player. If several share it, the game asks for the full name without saying who they are. Skipping a letter for free at a cost Skip any letter for free, but the skip resets your streak. Racking up names until the clock dies Rack up names until the clock dies, then chase your saved best. Alphabet Sprint rules: scoring, letters and the streak bonus Scoring points and the every fifth streak bonus Scoring is 1 point per correct player, and every 5th correct answer in a row pays 2. Reading the letter from a player's surname Surnames decide the letter: Kylian Mbappe answers M, not K, and suffixes are skipped, so Vinicius Junior counts under V. Weighting letters and grading Gold, Silver, Bronze Letters are weighted by how many unused players they hold, never repeat back to back, and any letter with fewer than 5 pool players never appears. The pool is every named player in this season's market table, about 5,500 of them, so if he is playing somewhere real right now he counts. Cover every playable letter for Gold, 75 percent for Silver, 50 percent for Bronze. Alphabet Sprint walkthrough: a fast Classic mode streak Chaining a fast start on Classic mode Classic mode, 45 seconds. M drops and Mbappe is in before the letter finishes animating. S brings Saka, B brings Bellingham, and the streak builds. Skipping a blank and still earning a badge Your fifth straight answer pays double. Then K lands, your mind goes blank, and you skip, swallowing the streak reset. Eleven names later it is 13 points and a Silver badge. Alphabet Sprint tips for speed, letters and skipping Typing surnames only to save seconds Type surnames only. Haaland beats Erling Haaland by half a second, and seconds are the currency. Keeping fallback names ready for deep letters Keep go-to names ready for the deep letters, because the wheel favors letters with lots of players left. Resolving the ambiguity message quickly If the ambiguity message appears, add a first name to the most famous option and resubmit. Do not freeze. Skipping instead of freezing on a blank Skipping is not failing. Four blank seconds cost more than any streak bonus returns. Alphabet Sprint FAQ: rejected answers and impossible letters Why was my answer rejected? Usually the surname does not start with the shown letter, the player was already used this run, or he is not in this season's market table (about 5,500 current players; retired players and youth prospects without a value are not in it). Accents and hyphens are forgiven. Do impossible letters like Q or X come up? No. Letters with fewer than 5 pool players are removed from the wheel before the run starts, so you are never stuck on an unanswerable letter. Is Alphabet Sprint free to play? Yes. Alphabet Sprint is free to play on DoUKnowBall, right in your browser. No download and no signup needed.
